release.name: ArgDigest 0.16.0
release.body:
ArgDigest 0.16.0 adds public registration-only diagnostics for application-owned SMonitor configuration (#32).

- With SMonitor 0.20.0 or newer, imports and `register_diagnostics()` register the catalog without configuring application policy, handlers or exception hooks.
- `configure_diagnostics()` preserves existing application configuration by default; `use_provider_policy=True` explicitly requests provider recommendations when supported.
- The CLI configures its own diagnostics, and optional type-check engine loading is deferred until use.
- Older supported providers retain legacy initialization and refuse explicit registration-only requests with an actionable capability error.

Python 3.11–3.14, the optional NumPy boundary and core dependency floors remain unchanged. Consumer adoption is independently owned.

The exact candidate passed the complete source matrix. One staged noarch artifact passed all twelve full installed cells with public SMonitor 0.21.0 / DepDigest 0.15.1 and all twelve NumPy-free lower-bound cells with SMonitor 0.16.0 / DepDigest 0.11.0. Registration-only and scoped-capture availability are mandatory in the full installed gate. Public Conda promotion and source-only Zenodo archival are verified separately in the release issue.

Artifact: `noarch/argdigest-0.16.0-py_0.tar.bz2`  
SHA-256: `e82d82680d79ae3d5df9917b1662d2855ed8485128943b72ddec87a5769a467d`  
Source: `2b9c9b289ae9b1d97d3bf04250f5c882feab3d41`

Release receipts and publication status: https://github.com/uibcdf/argdigest/issues/36.
Shared consumer coordination: https://github.com/uibcdf/molsyssuite/issues/106.

limits: No rebuild, replacement, retag, upload, promotion, historical-title change or scientific rerun.
Public provider evidence does not imply consumer receiving.
Public installation and source archive verification retain their own scope; do not infer them from guide/source or generic run conclusions.
